headline: 2026 Entry and Seasonal Road Access
reservation: Mount Rainier National Park will not require timed-entry reservations anywhere in the park in 2026. An entrance fee or valid pass is still required. Parking management, congestion, and road closures can affect access; check current NPS conditions and requirements for future seasons.

days.title: Glaciers and Wildflower Meadows

stops.name: Paradise / Skyline Trail
stops.detail: Walk through subalpine meadows toward the glaciated peaks, selecting an out-and-back distance suited to your group's stamina.

stops.name: Myrtle Falls
stops.detail: Follow the short paved path from Paradise for a view of the falls with the mountain backdrop, staying on designated trails.

days.driving: Allow 90 minutes from the Nisqually Entrance; winding park roads with strict limits
days.note: No timed-entry reservation is required in 2026; check current entrance, road, and parking conditions before driving to Paradise.

days.title: High Elevation Vistas and Basins

stops.name: Sunrise Point
stops.detail: Stop at this overlook for panoramic views of the Cascades and the Emmons Glacier before reaching the visitor center.

stops.name: Reflection Lakes
stops.detail: Pause for photos of the mountain's mirrored image, but check for seasonal road closures that affect access to this area.

days.driving: Allow 2.5 hours; significant elevation gain and slow curves
days.note: Sunrise is the highest point reachable by car and opens later in the season than Paradise.

days.title: Ancient Forests and Waterfalls

stops.name: Trail of the Shadows
stops.detail: Circumnavigate the meadow at Longmire to see historic park structures and old-growth trees on this level loop.

stops.name: Narada Falls
stops.detail: Walk down the steep, often wet trail for a full view of the falls; use caution as mist makes the path slippery.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; conditions vary with weather and construction
days.note: Longmire is generally accessible year-round, serving as a base when higher roads are snowed in.

intel.title: Congestion Management
intel.text: Paradise and Sunrise parking can reach capacity during busy periods. No timed-entry reservation is required in 2026; have a lower-elevation alternative ready and follow parking-management instructions.

intel.title: Connectivity Limits
intel.text: Cell service can be limited in mountainous areas. Download maps and current road information before leaving Ashford or Packwood; a timed-entry reservation QR code is not required in 2026.

intel.title: Gateway Stops
intel.text: There are no gas stations inside the park. Fuel up in Ashford, Packwood, or Enumclaw before beginning the ascent.

intel.title: Snow Clearance
intel.text: Upper roads to Sunrise and Paradise can remain closed due to snow late into June or July. Verify current road status on the NPS alerts page.

intel.title: Entry Windows
intel.text: No timed-entry windows apply in 2026. Consider a weekday visit or an early or late arrival to reduce congestion, while allowing enough daylight and checking seasonal road hours.

plan.arrival: Fly into Seattle-Tacoma International (SEA) and rent an SUV; stop in Puyallup or Enumclaw for groceries before the final drive to the park gates.
plan.vehicle: An RV is feasible but faces length restrictions on winding roads like Sunrise; check the NPS website for specific vehicle length limits per corridor.
plan.goldenHour: Sunrise Point offers views in early light when the road is open. Check seasonal road access and weather before departure; no timed-entry reservation is required in 2026.
